_source: Money model, agreed Oct 9; calibrated Oct 9 (PROPOSAL numbers). All amounts in EUR. TV: half split equally, half by final position. Prize money: a pot of 20% of TV, by position. Gate: home league games x capacity x fill (0.6 + 0.4 x mood/100, max 1) x ticket price (15 + 65 x (reputation/100)^1.5). Sponsors: 0.4 x league TV per club x 1.06^(reputation - 50). Store: 0.15 x league TV per club x 1.06^(reputation - 50) x (0.5 + mood/100). Expected wage: 0.28 x 50M x (market value / 50M)^0.65 x the league's wage level (stars ask a smaller share of their value; the same player earns less in a poorer league). Calibration: TV and wage levels set so the median club spends about 65% of income on wages (real football 60-70%). Wage bar (approved formula): league base x 1.025^(reputation - 50) x objective; bases set so the median club's wages are about 70% of its bar at the start (wages settle near 80% after a few seasons; changed Oct 9 for the transfer market), division 2 base = division 1 base / 4. Upkeep about 3% of income. Starting balance: half a season's income. Money never goes below zero (Oct 9).

renewal._note: Confirmed Oct 9: an expiring contract goes to a renewal negotiation; the outcome decides if he stays. AI clubs talk to players they still want (PROPOSAL): their best 26 by rating up to age 32, and prospects (23 and under) inside their best 30.

freeAgents._note: Free transfers added Oct 9: a player without a club joins for no fee if he accepts the wage (approved signing chance, +0.6 for his academy or a former club). AI rules are PROPOSALS: each AI club, best reputation first, approaches up to 3 free agents per window who are at least as good as its squad median and fit under its wage bar (standard objective). AI clubs below 16 players sign the best free agents they can afford.
